maddeler.e:
اغتصبن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَصَبْنَ (iḡtaṣabna) /iɣ.ta.sˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اُغْتُصِبْنَ (uḡtuṣibna) /uɣ.tu.sˤib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اِغْتَصِبْنَ (iḡtaṣibna) /iɣ.ta.sˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
